_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every host plugin manifest. Edit THIS file, then run `python3 scripts/gen_plugin_manifests.py`. Never hand-edit .*-plugin/*.json — they are generated and CI re-checks them.
name: project-lifecycle
_hostVersionOverrides_comment: Hosts whose version is DELIBERATELY not part of the synced set, per scripts/invariants/manifest-version-sync.sh: that invariant syncs exactly .claude-plugin, .qoder-plugin and .codebuddy-plugin, and excludes codex on the stated grounds that it carries its own X.Y.Z+codex.<stamp> scheme. Antigravity is excluded differently — its schema has no version field at all. Setting a host here means 'this host's version is independent by design', NOT 'this host is behind'.

descriptions.detailed: Doc-first per-phase workflow skill: brainstorm → spec → plan → execute → dual-track smoke → handoff → PR → milestone-done. Includes cost-aware behaviors (offset+limit reads, compact output flags, codemap pattern, RTK/token-savior adoption guidance).
descriptions.short: End-to-end coordinator for traceable, multi-phase software project execution.
descriptions.marketplace: End-to-end coordinator skill for traceable, multi-phase software project execution. Spec → plan → execute → smoke → handoff → PR discipline with built-in cost-aware behaviors.
descriptions.marketplaceEntry: Skill that enforces a doc-first per-phase workflow: brainstorm with research gate, planned execution with per-task cadence, dual-track smoke (manual + Playwright), phase delivery handoff, and milestone-done gate. Designed to be the same workflow across all your projects.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate software projects through intent clarification, research-backed planning, per-task execution, smoke testing, handoff notes, and PR-ready delivery discipline.
defaultPrompt: Use $project-lifecycle to plan and deliver this project phase.
